notes: All snapshots are Common Crawl captures; sourceUrl is the index lookup address printed in each file's footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp's date. No live copies were in the chunk. The UNSW snapshot folder also contains 20210919142054.txt, which chunk-100 lists, so it was not extracted here. Purdue (krannert): names come from two tables, "Examples of placements" (Initial Placement / Current Affiliation, no year) and "Recent examples of dissertation topics" (Graduation year / Dissertation title); the two are merged per person, so destination is the initial placement and the year is the stated graduation year; people only in the dissertation table have no placement; the "Current Affiliation" column is a later affiliation, not a placement. Texas Tech ISQS: the page is organised under year headings (2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2017 ... 1976) but the text capture lists all the years first and then all the entries, so the year of each person cannot be read from the capture and listedYear is null for every row; the entries appear in page order (most recent first, Kevin Harmon ... James C. Wetherbe), so the integrator may be able to recover years from the live page or another capture; "Original placement" is recorded as destination and "Current Position" in note; entries without an original placement have destination null; some destinations carry a title in parentheses as written; the page lists dissertation chairs, who are not recorded as graduates. Colorado Boulder: the page is a "sampling of recent placements" across five areas; "PhD: YYYY" is recorded as listedYear with yearMeaning graduation (the page labels the year "PhD"); "Placement" or "Initial Placement" is the destination and "Current Placement" goes in note; twelve people (Jenni Dinger, Jose Ramirez, Mark Zais, Subhamoy Ganguly, Shayne Kiefer, Daniel Lerner, Michele Samorani, Harald Reinertsen, Marilyn Uy, Marco Better, Fang Liang, Rahul Patil) appear under both "Organizational Behavior and Information Systems" and "Strategy, Entrepreneurship and Operations" and are merged into one row with both programs; Marilyn Uy's OB/IS entry has a mislabelled second "Dissertation:" line reading "Nanyang Technological University, Singapore" which the SEO entry labels "Current Placement"; Michael Loroz ("No information provided") and Tandy Dilworth ("N/A") have destination null; Caleb Warren's placement line embeds a current placement, split into destination and note; Jordan Martel's destination keeps "(visiting professor)" and Nhan Le's keeps "Post Doc at" as written. Lausanne: the page has no placement list, only six alumni testimonials with current titles and affiliations and a prose list of institutions; the six are recorded with the affiliation as destination and a note that it is a current affiliation, not a stated first placement; the prose institution list yields no rows. UNSW: "Recent placement highlights" per school, no years, names prefixed "Dr" (honorific dropped from name); position and destination split at the first comma; both snapshots recorded separately (the 2023 copy adds Yu Wu and Guillaume Boglioni Beaulieu, and Sandor Lukacs De Pereny is only in the 2022 copy). Oxford: "Placements" rows are under year headings (yearMeaning placement) in "Name - Institution - Title" form; "Job market candidates" have no year and are yearMeaning job-market; Beata Gafka and Johan Cassel appear both as 2022/2020 placements and as job market candidates (Johan Cassel Pegelow), merged as one row for Gafka and kept as two rows for Cassel/Cassel Pegelow because the names differ; the "Placement institutions" prose list has no names. The Oxford and Colorado pages mix finance, accounting, marketing and other fields with operations; only Colorado's "Strategy, Entrepreneurship and Operations" rows and Texas Tech's ISQS rows are likely operations-relevant.
